boundary: tenant ownership on a record read
scope: Synthetic owned lab; controlled accounts A and B.
hypothesis: Tenant A's account can read B's record.

artifacts.observation: UI displayed B's controlled canary after the operator switched the account selector to A.
The request producing E1 still carried B's authenticated session cookie; the selector had not replaced it.
After clearing the cookie and authenticating as A, the same B record returns 403; the result repeats twice.
